narrative.details:
All right, adventurer. I'm ready if you are.

Shall we?
narrative.objectives: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done a great service for us, adventurer. Thank you.

I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
narrative.requestItemsText: The time for talk is done. Protect Kinelory if you care about the people of Hillsbrad at all.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 33 to 37, 10,500 XP in all.
